newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian demonstrators rescue Israeli police.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian demonstrators rescue Israeli police.

text.p: Palestinian demonstrators came to the rescue of four Israeli police injured when their jeep overturned in Arab East Jerusalem on Saturday while on the way to quell an Arab protest, witnesses said.
They said the jeep of paramilitary border police was speeding towards a demonstration in Jabal al-Mukaber village near East Jerusalem when it crashed.
Palestinian demonstrators rushed to the soldiers, gave them water and helped them to ambulances.
Israel radio said two of the police were in moderate condition and two were injured lightly.
Israeli security forces had earlier shot and wounded three Palestinians during stone-throwing confrontations in Jabal al-Mukaber.

Nearly 70 Palestinians and Israelis were killed in three days of gunbattles and stone-throwing demonstrations across the West Bank and Gaza Strip this week triggered by Israel's opening of an archaeological tunnel near Jerusalem's al-Aqsa mosque, Islam's third holiest shrine.
